## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.1

### Home Assistant Compatibility Hotfix
- Restores X-Sense entity registration on newer Home Assistant builds where DeviceInfo no longer supports copy().
- Restores existing smoke alarm, base station, and sensor entities that were restored as unavailable because platform setup stopped at device registration.
- Adds regression coverage for the current Home Assistant DeviceInfo behavior.

### Cloud Credential Alignment
- Completes the X-Sense app's server-selected Cognito Identity credential flow for AWS device-shadow access when the account enables it.
- Keeps the existing legacy credential path for accounts that are not enabled for the newer flow.
- Clears identity credentials when the Cognito ID token changes so later shadow requests obtain credentials for the current session.

### Time Handling
- Uses UTC consistently for WebRTC ticket expiry, MQTT signature age, and synchronous X-Sense action timestamps.
